title: Meta Partners with Stegra for Environmental Attribute Certificates in Green Steel Initiative
dek: Meta has partnered with Stegra on environmental attribute certificates as part of a green steel initiative, according to Hydrogen Fuel News.
summary: Hydrogen Fuel News reports that Meta has partnered with Stegra, the green steel developer, for environmental attribute certificates under a green steel initiative. The headline does not give volumes, prices or the duration of the arrangement.
keyFacts: Meta has partnered with Stegra for environmental attribute certificates
whyItMatters: Purchases of certificates by large technology companies could create an extra revenue stream for low-emission steel projects, separate from sales of the physical metal.
implications: Green steel producers could find certificate-based offtake a useful way to monetise their premium. Readers should watch whether other corporate buyers adopt similar structures.
